quick: 0.1 mg fenpiverinium with pitofenone 5 mg and metamizole 500 mg per tablet, 1 to 2 tablets up to three times daily
summary: Fenpiverinium is an antimuscarinic given with pitofenone and metamizole (dipyrone) for colic. Metamizole carries a risk of agranulocytosis.
indications: Renal, biliary and intestinal colic; dysmenorrhoea (in combination)

dosage.d: 0.1 mg fenpiverinium with pitofenone 5 mg and metamizole 500 mg per tablet, 1 to 2 tablets up to three times daily

admin: Use only as the finished product directs

absolute: Metamizole contraindications: agranulocytosis history, G6PD deficiency, porphyria, marrow disease

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
